x: Mickey Pyer and Reg Hopkins keep a careful eye on the colts during a javelin throwing session at Battersea Park.

So to the election of Officers and Committee for 1972/73, with Clive Shippen taking over the President's chair from Mickey Pyer. "No change" was the cry as most offices came to be filled but a special note should be made of Bob Taylor's retirement from the Track Sec's job after many years of invaluable service.

It was good to see MICKEY PYER around again. CHARLIE CHURCHER was seen talking to old friends, whilst CHARLIE JONES, FRANK WEBB, NORMAN DEWBERRY and CHARLIE MacLENNAN were about doing various jobs around the course.
